title: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem planeswalker and Coalition member who can generate material from the Blind Eternities; he is captured by the Phyrexians and brought before Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who manages the Coalition's troops as general and quartermaster; he agrees to cross time to learn how to activate the sylex.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An artificer who runs the workshop on the Mana Rig and triggers its self-destruct mechanism to deny it to Sheoldred.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A planeswalker and mage who creates portals to evacuate the Coalition's troops and mourns Jaya.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A fire-wielding planeswalker who is killed by the compleated Ajani after trying to carry the sylex away.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who returns to fight beside Karn, then is revealed to have been compleated and to be the Coalition's spy for Sheoldred.

entities.name: Compleated Ajani
entities.description: Ajani after his Phyrexian musculature and wiring are revealed; he kills Jaya, crushes the sylex and is carried off with Karn.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: The Phyrexian praetor who attacks the Mana Rig with her armies, rides a dragon engine host body, and seizes Karn and Ajani.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A Phyrexian-revived mage with doubled arms who was left behind by the Weatherlight; he nearly pulls Karn apart.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: A dragon who leads the dragons against the compleated Weatherlight and the Phyrexian dreadnoughts.

entities.name: Meria
entities.description: A pale-skinned Yavimayan elf who arrives on a kavu with Jodah and coordinates the elven archers.

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: A Benalish knight who fights on the Mana Rig in her house's colors.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: A Keldon warrior who fights on the Mana Rig with her people's battle cry.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: An artificer who leads Teferi to her device in Urza's tower to help him cross time; she made a replica of the sylex.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor, glowing and insectile, who greets Karn as Father and shows him a sapling.

entities.name: Subira
entities.description: Teferi's late wife and the mother of his child.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Teferi's daughter, whose plane Teferi is trying to save.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A pupil whom Jaya patiently taught, remembered by Teferi.

entities.name: Mana Rig
entities.description: A huge Thran-era walking machine at Shiv with a helm, workshop and mana cannons; Jhoira wakes it and sets its self-destruct.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: An ancient artifact weapon that Karn has learned to activate; Karn encases it in titanium and Ajani crumples it.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: An airship that the Phyrexians have compleated and use against the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Golden Argosy
entities.description: A ship that carries Jaya, Ajani, Danitha, Radha and their Keldon and Benalish warriors to the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: The scarlet portal that Sheoldred opens to carry herself, Karn and Ajani off Dominaria.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The red desert and mountain region of Dominaria where the Mana Rig stands.

entities.name: Urza's tower
entities.description: The ancient tower where Saheeli's device waits and Teferi prepares to cross time.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A place where Teferi once mistook Jaya for a line cook.

entities.name: Caves of Koilos
entities.description: The place where Karn found a clay tablet and perhaps gave away more of himself.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane the Coalition is defending from Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, through which Karn draws material and the Planar Bridge travels.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated invaders under Sheoldred and Elesh Norn who attack the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The allied army of many species defending Dominaria from the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Magnigoths
entities.description: Huge walking trees that march across Shiv and drive the Phyrexians back, carrying Yavimayan elves.

entities.name: Yavimayan elves
entities.description: Elven archers who ride kavu and Magnigoths into the battle.

events.summary: Teferi brings Karn a captured Phyrexian saboteur that was in the food stores; Karn burns it in a crucible.
events.quote: It's the second saboteur I've found.

events.summary: Teferi apologizes to Karn for treating him as a thing, and Karn accepts.
events.quote: For what it's worth, Karn, I apologize for how I treated you in the past.

events.summary: A klaxon sounds as a vast Phyrexian army rises from the desert and begins to climb the Mana Rig.
events.quote: The first wave of Phyrexians scaled the Mana Rig's sides.

events.summary: Jhoira's cannons fire twice and bring down a Phyrexian dreadnought.
events.quote: It collapsed onto its own troops, crushing them.

events.summary: Karn sees that the Weatherlight has been compleated and is dropping Phyrexian horrors onto the deck.
events.quote: The Phyrexians had compleated the Weatherlight .

events.summary: Ertai, now a Phyrexian with doubled arms, leaps onto the Mana Rig and confronts Karn.
events.quote: It's been quite some time, old friend.

events.summary: Darigaaz and the dragons dive at the Weatherlight and rake its cables.
events.quote: Darigaaz threw himself at the Weatherlight 's hull

events.summary: Ertai's spell freezes Karn's joints, lifts him and begins to crush and pull him apart limb by limb.
events.quote: He was pulling Karn apart, limb by limb, like a cruel child torturing an insect.

events.summary: Believing he will die, Karn generates a titanium and carbon casing around the distant sylex to protect it.
events.quote: He spun the densest carbon filaments he could from the aether and encased the sylex in its lockbox in titanium.

events.summary: Ajani arrives on the Golden Argosy and knocks Ertai off the Mana Rig, freeing Karn.
events.quote: The Phyrexian mage stumbled backwards, concentration broken—and with a scream, tumbled over the side of the Mana Rig.

events.summary: Jaya, Danitha, Radha and the Keldon and Benalish warriors pour from the Argosy; Jaya burns Phyrexians with fire and lightning.
events.quote: Keldon warriors and Benalish knights poured from the Argosy onto the Mana Rig's decks.

events.summary: Sheoldred rises on a dragon-engine body and demands the sylex from Karn, showing his plan to draw her out had worked.
events.quote: You have the sylex for me.

events.summary: Sheoldred rams the Mana Rig and her army swarms up her body onto the upper deck.
events.quote: slammed her chest into the Mana Rig's bow section like a battering ram.

events.summary: Jhoira wakes the Mana Rig, which stands and tears free, strides across the desert and floods the Phyrexians with lava.
events.quote: The Mana Rig was free.

events.summary: Magnigoths and Yavimayan elves arrive and drive the Phyrexians back; Jodah and Meria land on the deck on a kavu and Jodah shields the cannons.
events.quote: rank upon rank of Magnigoths marched forward, darkening Shiv's deserts with their cool shadows and verdant foliage.

events.summary: Ajani's Phyrexian musculature bursts out and he is revealed as the compleated spy and traitor.
events.quote: Ajani had been compleated. He was the spy, the traitor.

events.summary: Compleated Ajani drives his axe into Jaya, and wounds Karn with it.
events.quote: He swept up his axe and drove into her body.

events.summary: Jaya burns Ajani's fur away to reveal wires, and he hurls her off the Mana Rig; she dies.
events.quote: With a thrust of his ruined hand, he hurled Jaya over the edge of the Mana Rig.

events.summary: Ajani crumples the sylex in his hand, destroying it.
events.quote: he lifted the sylex—and crumpled it in his hand, as if the ancient artifact were made of nothing more than paper.

events.summary: Sheoldred slams into the Mana Rig again, splits from her host body, reveals a stolen face and tells Karn the next step in evolution will be compleated.
events.quote: The next step in evolution will be compleated.

events.summary: Jhoira triggers the Mana Rig's self-destruct mechanism and orders Jodah to portal everyone out.
events.quote: Jhoira had triggered the Mana Rig's self-destruct mechanism.

events.summary: Jodah portals Danitha, Radha, Meria and the troops to safety and steps through his final portal.
events.quote: Jodah pulled up a portal and threw Danitha, Radha, and Meria into it

events.summary: A scarlet Planar Bridge opens and carries Sheoldred, Ajani and Karn away from Dominaria.
events.quote: it . . . stole him away.

events.summary: Teferi and Jhoira organize the survivors, and Jodah, holding Karn's necklace and a lock of Jaya's hair, mourns her.
events.quote: I can't let go of her. I just got her back again.

events.summary: Teferi, Jodah and Jhoira build a monument to Jaya in Shiv's desert; Teferi leaves an empty pyramid for Karn.
events.quote: Jodah, Teferi, and Jhoira had remained to build this: a monument for Jaya.

events.summary: Saheeli leads Teferi to her device in Urza's tower, where he resolves to cross time to learn how to activate the sylex.
events.quote: Teferi would do the one thing he had vowed never to do: cross time itself.

events.summary: Karn arrives in a Phyrexian cavern and is welcomed by Elesh Norn, who calls him Father.
events.quote: Welcome, Father.

events.summary: Elesh Norn shows the helpless Karn a small oil-beaded sapling and calls it the beginning of everything.
events.quote: It is the beginning of great things, Father.

relations.note: Ajani was the spy who betrayed the Coalition to Sheoldred.
Ajani stabbed Jaya and hurled her off the Mana Rig.
relations.quote: With a thrust of his ruined hand, he hurled Jaya over the edge of the Mana Rig.

relations.note: Ertai, once a friend, tries to pull Karn apart.
relations.quote: Anything that has been built can be disassembled.

relations.note: Norn calls Karn her Father, as her creator.
Jhoira built the Mana Rig and wakes it.
relations.quote: Jhoira must have completed her work, and she'd woken the Mana Rig.

relations.note: Subira was Teferi's late wife and the mother of his child.
relations.quote: She'd been the love of his life, and the mother of his child.

relations.note: Old friends who comfort each other.
relations.quote: Jodah leaned into that old familiarity.

relations.note: Meria fights alongside Radha and Danitha and coordinates her archers behind them.
relations.quote: Meria fell in beside Radha and Danitha
